legend.0: fails open — silently continues, invents a plausible value, or swallows the error
legend.1: degrades without marking the degraded state — downstream still treats the result as good
legend.2: propagates the failure or returns an explicit degraded/error state
legend.3: rejects strictly before any side effect

legend.0: one call site; the next recompute overwrites it
legend.1: one UI surface's text or one transient state
legend.2: persisted state, or a number shown to the user as fact
legend.3: sizing results, money figures, or data sent off-device

legend.0: little — trivial, or fully covered elsewhere
legend.1: some — a regression here would be annoying but visible
legend.2: a lot — a regression here could silently corrupt a user-facing answer
legend.3: critical — this guards money, safety, privacy, or the sizing engine's math
